name: Gemma 4 LiteRT Wiki
description: Karpathy's LLM-wiki pattern, run by Gemma 4 entirely inside Obsidian through LiteRT-LM and WebGPU. Ingest notes into a wiki the model maintains (index, tags, links) and chat grounded in what you wrote. Free; one-time model download, then offline.
